# Motion › Push Slide

**What belongs here.** B pushes A out, or slides over it.

**Examples.** push left, slide up, card stack

**Family test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Push](push/) | The new scene pushes the old one out of frame. |
| [Slide Over](slide-over/) | The new scene slides in over the old one like a card, with a soft shadow, while the old one drifts back and dims. |
